label.fr: Jours de retard comptés (3 ans au plus)

citation.fr: Code des impôts de Géorgie, article 272(2), (2¹), (4)

legal_source.note: Art. 272(4): 0.05% of the outstanding tax liability for each overdue day; the day of payment counts as overdue. 272(2): assessed for each overdue day from the day after the due date, on the outstanding liability net of overpaid taxes (overpayments not encoded: input.tax_due is the net unpaid amount). 272(2¹): not assessed once 3 years have passed since the obligation to assess it arose; encoded as at most 1 095 days (leap days ignored). Not encoded: 272(3)-(3¹) insolvency/rehabilitation, 272(6) interest from the 30th day after a Tax Notice, 272(7) exempt budget suppliers and projects. days_late = payment date minus due date. effective_from is the publication date of Law No 4056 (14.3.2024), the latest amendment to Art. 272 in the rad_law snapshot, not a verified entry-into-force date. Needs review by a qualified accountant before last_verified_date is set.

label.en: 5% for each started month (up to 2 months late)
label.ru: 5% за каждый начатый месяц (просрочка до 2 месяцев)
label.fr: 5 % par mois entamé (jusqu’à 2 mois de retard)

citation.fr: Code des impôts de Géorgie, article 274

legal_source.note: Art. 274(1): filing late by no more than 2 months: 5% of the tax to be assessed on the return for each overdue complete/incomplete month (incomplete months count as one), at most 30% in total (never reached within 2 months). 274(2): more than 2 months late: 10% of that tax. 274(3): no fine if the tax on the return is zero. months_late = the number of started months from the due date to the filing date. effective_from is the publication date of Law No 4225 (31.12.2018), the latest amendment to Art. 274 in the rad_law snapshot, not a verified entry-into-force date. Needs review by a qualified accountant before last_verified_date is set.
